messages:
lina_cs: Drafting a compact customer priming & runbook thread for high-risk onboardings. Goal: reduce cold-start errors, keep streaming stable, and capture early feedback for renewal signals. Posting so CS can adopt and test. :seedling:

mike: love it. can we make the instructions actionable at 0-24h, 24-72h, 7d?

lina_cs: yes. quick outline below with exact commands and a tiny config.

24h checklist:
- validate network & API keys (ask engineering for TLS/KMS check)
- enable telemetry tags: `cs.onboard_id`, `client_tier`, `go_live_ts`
- seed prefill: upload top 5 prompts via console prefills UI
- start warm pool: warm_pool_size=3 minimum; run smoke load for 3 minutes

24-72h checklist:
- run adaptive batching config
- monitor token-level latency & stream drop rate
- schedule 30m product walkthrough (must happen within 48h of go-live)
- capture customer feedback survey at 24h (link below)

7d checklist:
- check support ticket count and errors; if >2 tickets or error_rate>0.05 -> mark renewal_risk=high and schedule account review
- collect NPS + 2 q's (prefill helpful? streaming stable?)

sample adaptive config snippet:
```yaml
prefetch: true
warm_pool: true
warm_pool_size: 3
batching:
  mode: adaptive
  min_batch: 4
  max_batch: 16
  target_latency_ms: 140
streaming:
  fallback_on_timeout: true
  timeout_threshold_pct: 1.0
telemetry_tags: ["cs.onboard_id","client_tier","prefill_flow"]
```

devon: suggest starting with min_batch=4 for chat-heavy, min_batch=8 for non-chat inference. also add `reserve_quota_pct=8` to avoid noisy neighbors during ramp.

lina_cs: added that. also included a tiny troubleshooting matrix below.

troubleshooting quick fixes:
- streaming timeouts spike on smoke test (>2%): reduce max_batch or increase target_latency_ms by +20ms, re-run smoke test
- token errors jump: rollback to earlier model variant (tagged `stable`) and open a ticket with eng-runtime
- warm pool not filling: check instance allocation with `ops list-warmpools --id <onboard_id>`

ops-bot: command: `ops create-dashboard --filter "cs.onboard_id:<id>" --metrics latency,tokens,stream_errors --preset onboard_smoke` -> returns URL. :robot_face:

arun: for renewal scoring I propose a compact rubric saved to CRM field `onboard_health_score`:
- 90-100: green (ok)
- 70-89: yellow (monitor + outreach)
- <70: red (CS+AE sync + remediation plan)
store the score as integer 0-100 and add short reason tag.

sasha: feedback capture cadence: 24h (quick survey), 72h (CS check-in), 7d (NPS + structured questions). Use this 3-question form: 1) Did prefill reduce QA time? (yes/no), 2) Any streaming issues? (short text), 3) Overall satisfaction 1-10. link: https://forms.redwood/cs-priming-feedback

lina_cs: final rollout ask: CS please run this on next 3 onboardings flagged medium/high risk. paste results as one-line: `onboard_id | success/fail | main action taken | follow-up`

mike: will run on two customers this week. i'll post outcomes here.

devon: tagging eng-runtime and infra for FYI. if we see repeated rollbacks, need an auto-fallback route in routing policies.

lina_cs: thanks all. will iterate after first 3 datapoints. cc @ops-bot for dashboard creation shortcut. :sparkles:
